title: AI Ops Engineer
description: The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team. In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production. Cloud Platform Engineering: Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads. AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines: Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation. CI/CD Automation: Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components. Infrastructure as Code: Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments. Containerization & Orchestration: Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads. Observability & Reliability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production. Security & Governance: Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards. Developer Enablement: Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production. Skills Knowledge Required Cloud Platform: Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager. DevOps / SRE Practices: Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging. AI-Ops / LLMOps: Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs. Scripting & Automation: Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators. Software Engineering Fundamentals: Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably. Security & Compliance: Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments. Analytics Workflow Understanding: Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them. Qualifications Experience Education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline. DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience: 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production. AI/MLOps Engineering: Proven track record of implementing CI/CD for AI workloads, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure management (Terraform, Cloud Build, GKE). Automation & Reliability: Demonstrated experience with infrastructure automation, incident response, and building observable, self-healing production systems. Good to Have (Optional):: Previous exposure to the Banking, Financial Services, or Credit Analytics industries. Experience with Machine Learning engineering and model serving frameworks, or relevant cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer / Cloud Architect).

title: Associate Technical Lead, Software Development
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. Division: EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process. KLA's eBeam Division is seeking a passionate software Engineer to join us in delivering high quality solutions for our current and future generation products in our portfolio. We work on exciting problems that fuel the next gen technological advancements in the world! You will be working in teams that build customer critical User interface and Business logic software solutions having a direct impact on the semi-conductor manufacturing processes. Do you consider yourself as a big picture thinker with solid fundamentals of computer science; an innovator with a curiosity about connecting the dots? Someone who loves to dive deep and is keen on delivering indispensable value to customers? If this sounds like you! We strongly believe you to be a perfect fit for this role. You will work alongside a team of impactful individuals working with outstanding talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups. You will have the opportunity to learn, design, lead feature development, contribute and collaborate in developing end-to-end software from requirements to delivery. You should be somebody who feels strongly about writing high performing code and would be keen on applying and advocating clean coding practices. The role would require the following key skills: Expert level experience in working with Microsoft .Net and/or C++ programming. Solid Object oriented programming fundamentals. Be responsible for the analysis and addressing of complex requirements in the current software systems for usability and performance. Be responsible for developing innovative architectures , design and prototypes and working on solutions for new concepts that would scale for multiple products. Interest and Ability to uncover root causes, devise and drive innovative analyses and solve difficult problems that span whole systems or organizations is crucial. Good debugging skills in a complex software setup involving multi-process/multiple systems in Windows environment with good OS concepts Knowledge of Semiconductor Factory Automation systems and standards is an added advantage. Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering practices. Strong verbal and written communication and team-work skills We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. The culture is deeply rooted in collaboration and ongoing development, offering team members abundant opportunities for professional advancement and skill improvement. Emphasizing innovation excellence and cultural expansion, the company greatly values the diversity of its workforce, believing it to be a cornerstone of its success. Role Overview Valor Paytech is seeking an experienced DB Engineer to ensure our databases remain available, secure, and stable. The Database Engineer will continuously test data integrity to guard against corruption and perform regular updates to keep pace with evolving database technologies, while supporting performance, scalability, and reliability across our environments. Key Responsibilities Database Administration & Maintenance Monitor the health of database servers through both automated and manual processes. Perform environment setup and configuration, along with proactive monitoring and maintenance. Perform database administration and maintenance, including installation, configuration, backups, upgrades, and patching. Set up and maintain automatic backup and recovery mechanisms using cronjobs. Administer and maintain end-user accounts, permissions, and access rights. Performance & Optimization Recommend and implement solutions for performance monitoring and tuning. Evaluate the performance of stored procedures, identify time- and resource-consuming areas, and provide input to application developers to address them. Analyze access patterns and propose the best combination of indexes, constraints, foreign keys, and queries. Review SQL code written by application developers to ensure compliance with coding standards, best practices, and maximum performance. Review, optimize, and develop queries based on requirements. Reliability & Troubleshooting Analyze problems, anticipate future problem areas, and implement solutions. Investigate and identify the root cause of software problems reported by stakeholders. Troubleshoot database and Linux server issues by analyzing logs and using command-line utilities. Maintain scalability (clustering) and availability (replication), including working knowledge of Galera cluster. Proactively identify technical opportunities and enhancements while addressing major incidents in a timely manner. Participate in an on-call rotation providing 24x7 support, including off-hours maintenance windows. Data Governance & Security Manage and ensure the integrity, security, and retention of data. Create deployment and rollback scripts for all database objects, manually or auto-generated. Collaboration & Delivery Support the development of long- and short-term requirements for database administration and design. Participate in the change control process for all planned application and technical activities. Work with report writers to provide the data needed for reports. Take on full roadmap items, work with other functional teams, and deliver high-quality results on time. Direct the organization of requirements and data into a usable database schema, including development of ad hoc queries, scripts, and updates to existing queries. Work closely with the application development team, including query review and version control via GitLab. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline is required; equivalent experience may substitute for the education requirement. 3+ years of experience with relational databases such as MariaDB, MySQL, NoSQL, and above. 3+ years of experience with automation using shell scripting (Shell, Perl, Python, etc.). Working understanding of technologies including MariaDB/MySQL, NoSQL, and PostgreSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.). Working technical knowledge and experience with current Linux operating systems. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Proficient in relational databases, backup, and recovery. Comfortable with shell scripting and related scripting procedures. Preferred Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with MySQL; PostgreSQL is a plus but optional. Experience with Aurora/RDS, ProxySQL, and Percona / PMM / Grafana. Knowledge of Galera cluster for clustering, scalability, and replication-based availability. Experience working with application development teams, including query review and GitLab. Strong exposure to Linux resource and process monitoring, and scripting basics (shell, Python, or similar). Key Competencies Analytical & Problem-Solving Mindset Database Reliability & Performance Tuning Automation-First Approach Ownership & Incident Response Collaboration with Development Teams Technical Environment Databases: MariaDB, MySQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra), Aurora/RDS Clustering & Availability: Galera Cluster, Replication Monitoring: Percona, PMM, Grafana Proxy/Access: ProxySQL Scripting: Shell, Perl, Python Operating Systems: Linux Version Control: GitLab

title: Senior Network Engineer
description: Job Description: The Team We're a global R&D / Innovation team across the Middle East, Asia, and Europe, building the next generation of software-defined automation (SDA). We close the gap between today's automation systems and tomorrow's open, software-defined plants, turning emerging standards and technologies into solutions that matter. The Role You'll join a team of automation and software engineering experts, designing, testing, validating, and troubleshooting network architectures that address critical customer needs . You'll also own the testing and verification lab network, ensuring it performs reliably and remains optimized. Working across both IT and OT systems , you'll turn bold ideas into high-impact, real-world innovations through hands-on engineering. What You'll Do Serve as the networking expert for global and cross-functional teams , supporting Engineered Solutions and verification and validation activities in local and remote labs. Manage the operation, maintenance, and upgrades of multiple local and remote lab networks. Design, configure, and troubleshoot Layer 2/Layer 3 networks , including VLANs, routing, switching, redundancy, link aggregation, and network segmentation. Evaluate and validate new networking technologies for software-defined and OPA-based automation, and turn results into reference architectures . Troubleshoot complex network issues using packet capture and protocol analysis , addressing latency, packet loss, routing, MTU, interface errors, and performance issues. Implement network security and resilience controls , including firewalls, ACLs, VLAN/VRF segmentation, secure management access, redundancy, and device hardening. Design and maintain lab networks that span physical switches, hypervisors, and container hosts, including VLAN trunking into VMs and container networking. Must-Have Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field, with 5 + years of experience in network design, testing, troubleshooting, and industrial process-control network infrastructure. Strong knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking , including TCP/IP, IP addressing, subnetting, routing, VLANs, trunking, multicast, IGMP snooping, QoS, network segmentation, and RSTP across diverse network topologies. Hands-on experience with at least one industrial network redundancy protocol (such as MRP, PRP/HSR, DLR, or ERPS), including testing failover, recovery and convergence times, latency, and packet loss. Proficiency with network equipment, monitoring, and troubleshooting tools , including Wireshark, SNMP, Syslog, and port mirroring/SPAN. Hands-on experience with industrial networking platforms such as Cisco Industrial Ethernet, Hirschmann, or Moxa. Experience developing technical network documentation , including test plans, test reports, topology diagrams, and configuration documentation. Experience with OT cybersecurity architecture , including firewalls, DMZs, network zoning/segmentation, secure remote access, and defense-in-depth principles aligned with ISA/IEC 62443. Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, and IEC 61850. Professional certification in networking or OT cybersecurity (such as CCNP Enterprise, Juniper JNCIP-ENT, or an ISA/IEC 62443 certificate). Strong written and spoken English , with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to a global team. Nice-to-Have Experience with virtual and container networking on Linux hosts and hypervisors, including Linux bridges, Open vSwitch, VLAN trunking to VMs, and Docker networking (bridge, macvlan). Experience with time synchronization and deterministic networking , including PTP (IEEE 1588) and TSN. Familiarity with FAT/SAT, commissioning, migration, and cutover activities , including troubleshooting live industrial networks while minimizing operational disruption. Experience with n etwork automation and monitoring using Python or Ansible, and tools such as Zabbix.
